column1: # Hand-picked pack membership, unioned with the keyword lexicons in curate.py.
# Some packs cannot be expressed as keywords. "Explaining the World" is the
# history of learning how to find things out, in the sense of Weinberg's To
# Explain the World -- a lexicon for it pulls in Ptolemy the general along with
# Ptolemy the astronomer, and every university and space probe ever launched.
# So it is chosen by hand, one event at a time.
# NOTE the slug here is of the FINAL text (as it appears in events.json), not
# the raw scrape that curation.tsv and rewrites.tsv key on -- this file is
# applied after those two have run.
